verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You are my refuge, my rock, my guide
I surrender all, I surrender all, in you I confide

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
With each breath that I take, with each song that I sing
I will worship, I will praise

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
My Saviour and King
My Saviour and King

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Come reign over me
Come reign over me
